name: 盖乌斯·屋大维
description: 恺撒的甥孙和养子。18岁，体弱多病但意志如钢。最致命的武器不是剑，而是耐心和政治天才。
description_en: Caesar's adopted son and heir. 18 years old, sickly but iron-willed. His deadliest weapon is not the sword, but patience and political genius.

name: 马库斯·安东尼
description: 恺撒的副将和多年战友。战场上无可匹敌的勇士，政治上却总是输给耐心。
description_en: Caesar's lieutenant and long-time comrade. Unmatched warrior on the battlefield, but always loses to patience in politics.

name: 马库斯·布鲁图斯
description: 共和国自由的最后守护者。刺杀恺撒是为了理想而非权力，但理想无法阻挡军团。
description_en: The last defender of republican liberty. He killed Caesar for ideals, not power — but ideals cannot stop legions.

name: 盖乌斯·卡西乌斯
description: 刺杀阴谋的真正策划者。比布鲁图斯更现实，更危险，但无法摆脱命运。
description_en: The calculating mind behind Caesar's assassination alongside Brutus. A capable general who underestimated the tide of change Caesar had set in motion.

name: 克利奥帕特拉七世
description: 埃及最后一位伟大的法老。会说九种语言，比她的罗马对手们更聪明——但这还不够。
description_en: The last Pharaoh of Egypt, cunning as the Nile. Her greatest weapon is neither gold nor armies, but a charm that makes Roman generals forget their duty.

name: 塞克斯图斯·庞培
description: 庞培大帝仅存的儿子。从西班牙残部到海上霸主，复仇是他唯一的燃料。
description_en: Son of Pompey the Great, he wages a naval guerrilla war from Sicily, harassing the Triumvirs' supply lines. A pirate king with a legitimate claim.

name: 马库斯·雷必达
description: 三巨头中的老三。军事能力平平，政治野心有限——因此活得比另两人都久。
description_en: The forgotten third of the Triumvirate. Competent but uninspiring, he holds the balance only until the two titans no longer need him. He controls Hispania, Africa, and Narbonensis.

name: 马库斯·西塞罗
description: 共和国最伟大的演说家。能说服任何人却无法拯救共和国。言辞不能阻挡刀剑。
description_en: The Republic's greatest orator. He could persuade anyone yet could not save the Republic. Words cannot stop swords.

name: 马库斯·阿格里帕
description: 屋大维的童年好友和最杰出的将军。从未输过一场战役，却始终甘居幕后。亚克兴海战的总设计师。
description_en: Octavian's childhood friend and foremost general. Never lost a battle, yet always remained in the shadows. The mastermind behind the Battle of Actium.

name: 盖乌斯·梅塞纳斯
description: 屋大维的外交家和宣传大师。在屋大维打仗时，他负责让罗马城保持忠诚。
description_en: Octavian's diplomat and propaganda master. While Octavian fought wars, he kept Rome loyal.

name: 屋大维娅
description: 屋大维的姐姐。嫁给安东尼以维系同盟，成为罗马最著名的悲情妻子。
description_en: Octavian's sister. Married to Antony to hold the alliance together, becoming Rome's most famous tragic wife.

name: 富尔维娅
description: 安东尼的悍妻。在丈夫缺席时以铁腕统治意大利，发动佩鲁西亚战争对抗屋大维。
description_en: Antony's fierce wife. Ruled Italy with an iron fist in her husband's absence, waging the Perusine War against Octavian.

name: 托勒密十五世·恺撒里昂
description: 恺撒与克利奥帕特拉之子。他的存在本身就是对屋大维继承权的挑战——这注定了他的命运。
description_en: Son of Caesar and Cleopatra. His very existence challenged Octavian's claim to inheritance — and sealed his fate.

name: 奥罗德斯四世
description: 帕提亚万王之王。曾在卡莱消灭克拉苏的七个军团，等待罗马人再次犯错。
description_en: King of Kings of Parthia. Destroyed Crassus's seven legions at Carrhae, waiting for the Romans to make another mistake.

name: 希律大帝
description: 犹太的王。在罗马内战中反复转换阵营，永远站在胜利者一边。
description_en: King of Judea. Switched sides repeatedly during Rome's civil wars, always ending up on the winning side.
